content.title: Who is Christopher Abbott, Aubrey Plaza's boyfriend? Actress pregnant 1 year after husband's death
content.text: Aubrey Plaza is entering a new chapter in her life. The actress has confirmed she is expecting her first child with her partner, Christopher Abbott, just over a year after the death of her husband, Jeff Baena.Aubrey Plaza is pregnantA source told PEOPLE that Aubrey Plaza is expecting her first child and is due this fall."It was a beautiful surprise after an emotional year," the source said, adding that "they feel very blessed.A representative for Plaza also confirmed the news, marking a deeply personal milestone following a period of grief and transition for the actress.A relationship built over timePlaza, 41, and Abbott, 40, share a long professional history that eventually evolved into a romantic relationship.The two previously worked together on the 2020 indie film Black Bear and starred in the Off-Broadway revival of Danny and the Deep Blue Sea between 2023 and 2024.Their creative chemistry on screen and stage gradually developed into a personal bond, though they have kept much of their relationship private.Who is Christopher Abbott?Christopher Abbott is a respected American actor known for his work across television, film, and theater.He first gained widespread recognition for his role in the HBO series Girls, and has since built a reputation in both independent cinema and mainstream productions.Some of his most notable credits include:James WhiteIt Comes at NightFirst ManPossessorPoor ThingsOn television, he has appeared in The Sinner and Catch-22, earning critical acclaim and award nominations.Abbott is also an accomplished stage actor. He is currently starring on Broadway in the revival of Death of a Salesman, written by Arthur Miller, alongside Nathan Lane and Laurie Metcalf.A new beginning after lossThe pregnancy comes just over a year after the death of Jeff Baena in January 2025. Although Plaza and Baena had reportedly separated months before his passing, the loss had a profound emotional impact on the actress.Now, with Abbott by her side, Plaza appears to be embracing a new stage in her life-one defined by healing, love, and the anticipation of motherhood.The news has been widely received as a hopeful turning point, reflecting a journey from grief to renewal.
